candidateDiscoveryRules: Discover active, unshadowed event option ai_chance definitions through the shared index.
eligibilityRules: Evaluate source eligibility and declared candidate overrides with three-valued logic.
adapter.evaluationCadence: when the event option pool is selected
limitations: Runtime selection uses the engine d100 path; sub-one-percent outcomes are flagged.
modifierOrder: Evaluate the base expression, then source add/factor operations and modifiers in source order.
Apply declared external factors only after source-local operations.
poolNormalizationRules: Normalize non-negative eligible values only when the local candidate pool is complete.
scopeExpectations: event option root scope declared by the scenario
supportedExpressions: scenario-bound ROOT/THIS/PREV/FROM scope chains, saved scopes, and event targets
declared dynamic scope-pool filters with uniform or proportional selection
timingConversion: No time-distribution conversion is claimed for this adapter.
unsupportedConstructs: Runtime selection uses the engine d100 path; sub-one-percent outcomes are flagged.
